{{DISPLAYTITLE:_RGB32}}
{{QBDLDATE:2024-01-01}}
{{QBDLTIME:00:00:00}}
'''_RGB32''' returns a 32-bit colour value.

{{PageSyntax}}
{{CodeStart}}
colour~& = _RGB32(red, green, blue)
{{CodeEnd}}

{{PageDescription}}
* Red, green and blue are {{InlineCode}}0{{InlineCodeEnd}}–{{InlineCode}}255{{InlineCodeEnd}}.
